{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "# This workflow builds Grain wheels and uploads them as artifacts.

name: Build & Publish Template

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      pypi_project_url:
        required: true
        type: string
      run_tests_with_bazel:
        required: true
        type: boolean
      is_nightly:
        required: true
        type: boolean
      is_ci_tests:
        required: true
        type: boolean

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    name: "Python ${{ matrix.python-version }} on ${{ matrix.os }}"
    runs-on: "${{ matrix.os }}"
    timeout-minutes: 60

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.11", "3.12", "3.13", "3.14"]
        os: [ubuntu-22.04, ubuntu-22.04-arm, macos-15, windows-2022]
        is-ci-tests:
          - ${{ inputs.is_ci_tests }}
        exclude:
          - is-ci-tests: true
        include:
          - python-version: "3.11"
            os: ubuntu-22.04
          - python-version: "3.12"
            os: macos-15
          - python-version: "3.13"
            os: windows-2022
          - python-version: "3.14"
            os: ubuntu-22.04-arm

    env:
      USE_BAZEL_VERSION: "7.2.1"
    steps:
      - name: Set up Bazel
        uses: bazel-contrib/setup-bazel@4fd964a13a440a8aeb0be47350db2fc640f19ca8 # 0.15.0
      - name: Check Bazel installation
        run: |
          which bazel
          bazel version
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@ece7cb06caefa5fff74198d8649806c4678c61a1 # v6.3.0
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      - name: Install rsync for Windows
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        run: choco install --no-progress rsync
      - uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6.1.0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Cache Bazel output base
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/bazel
          key: bazel-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('MODULE.bazel') }}
          restore-keys: |
            bazel-${{ runner.os }}-
      - name: Create directory and set TEMP_DIR
        if: runner.os == 'Linux' || runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          mkdir -p /tmp/grain
          cp -r . /tmp/grain
          echo "TEMP_DIR=/tmp/grain" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "WHL_DIR=/tmp/grain" >> $GITHUB_ENV
      - name: Set TEMP_DIR
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        run: |
          echo "TEMP_DIR=${PWD}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "WHL_DIR=." >> $GITHUB_ENV
      - name: Build package
        run: |
          set -xe
          export PYTHON_VERSION=${{ matrix.python-version }}
          export PYTHON_MAJOR_VERSION=$(echo $PYTHON_VERSION | cut -d. -f1)
          export PYTHON_MINOR_VERSION=$(echo $PYTHON_VERSION | cut -d. -f2)
          export BAZEL_VERSION="${USE_BAZEL_VERSION}"
          export OUTPUT_DIR="${TEMP_DIR}"
          export SOURCE_DIR="${TEMP_DIR}"
          export RUN_TESTS_WITH_BAZEL=${{ inputs.run_tests_with_bazel }}
          export IS_NIGHTLY=${{ inputs.is_nightly }}
          . "${SOURCE_DIR}"'/grain/oss/runner_common.sh'
          build_and_test_grain
      - name: Smoke test built wheel
        if: ${{ (inputs.is_ci_tests == 'false' || inputs.is_ci_tests == false) && (inputs.run_tests_with_bazel == 'true' || inputs.run_tests_with_bazel == true) }}
        env:
          IS_NIGHTLY: ${{ inputs.is_nightly }}
        run: |
          set -xe
          SMOKE_DIR="${RUNNER_TEMP}/grain_wheel_smoke_test"
          rm -rf "${SMOKE_DIR}"
          mkdir -p "${SMOKE_DIR}"
          python -m venv "${SMOKE_DIR}/venv"
          if [ -x "${SMOKE_DIR}/venv/bin/python" ]; then
            VENV_PYTHON="${SMOKE_DIR}/venv/bin/python"
          else
            VENV_PYTHON="${SMOKE_DIR}/venv/Scripts/python.exe"
          fi
          "${VENV_PYTHON}" -m pip install "${WHL_DIR}"/all_dist/grain*.whl
          cd "${SMOKE_DIR}"
          "${VENV_PYTHON}" - <<'EOF'
          import importlib.metadata
          import os
          import pathlib
          import grain
          from grain.proto import execution_summary_pb2

          wheel_path = pathlib.Path(grain.__file__).resolve()
          assert any(p.lower() == "site-packages" for p in wheel_path.parts), (
              f"Expected grain imported from site-packages, got {wheel_path}"
          )

          expected_dist = (
              "grain-nightly"
              if os.environ.get("IS_NIGHTLY", "").lower() == "true"
              else "grain"
          )
          dist = importlib.metadata.distribution(expected_dist)
          if expected_dist == "grain-nightly":
            assert ".dev" in dist.version, (
                f"Expected .dev version for grain-nightly, got {dist.version}"
            )

          assert execution_summary_pb2.ExecutionSummary() is not None
          shuffled = grain.experimental.index_shuffle(
              index=0, max_index=9, seed=42, rounds=4
          )
          assert 0 <= shuffled <= 9

          ds = (
              grain.MapDataset.range(10)
              .shuffle(seed=42)
              .map(lambda x: x + 1)
              .to_iter_dataset()
          )
          assert sorted(list(ds)) == list(range(1, 11))
          EOF
      - name: Upload Grain artifacts
        if: ${{ inputs.is_ci_tests == 'false' || inputs.is_ci_tests == false }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@b7c566a772e6b6bfb58ed0dc250532a479d7789f # v6.0.0
        with:
          name: built-grain-wheels-${{ matrix.os }}-${{ matrix.python-version }}
          path: "${{ env.WHL_DIR }}/all_dist/*.whl"

  publish-wheel:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    if: ${{ inputs.is_ci_tests == 'false' || inputs.is_ci_tests == false }}
    needs: build-and-test
    permissions:
      id-token: write
    environment:
      name: pypi
      url: ${{ inputs.pypi_project_url }}
    steps:
      - name: Download Grain artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@37930b1c2abaa49bbe596cd826c3c89aef350131 # v7.0.0
        with:
          pattern: built-grain-wheels-*
          path: dist/
          merge-multiple: true
      - name: Publish package distributions to PyPI
        uses: pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish@7245906fb61fa33a13554f9d5fb856fe61758086 # v1.14.3
        with:
          attestations: false
          skip-existing: ${{ inputs.is_nightly }}
          verbose: true",
  "rationale": "The workflow builds with Bazel (USE_BAZEL_VERSION: 7.2.1) and the repository contains MODULE.bazel, confirming an existing Bazel build. Evidence pattern P-LIT-BAZEL-INCREMENTAL (Cache Bazel build results) reports result caching particularly helped long compilations, with preconditions of an existing Bazel build and a trusted, input-keyed cache both satisfied. Adding a GitHub Actions cache for the Bazel output base (~/.cache/bazel), keyed on runner OS and MODULE.bazel, reuses prior build outputs across matrix jobs and reruns without changing build targets, test selection, or required checks. The cache is additive: a miss simply rebuilds from scratch, so coverage is preserved. No permissions are weakened, no secrets or privileged actions are added, and no new network access beyond the existing GitHub Actions cache service is introduced.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-BAZEL-INCREMENTAL"]
}
